run_benchmark_transformer_fusion_pattern: run the benchmark to profile and time transformer fusion patterns using memory_efficient_fusion
run_memory_efficient_fusion: run memory_efficient_fusion on a PyTorch function with static argnums to get an optimized fused function
run_clear_compile_cache: run clear_compile_cache to clear the functorch compile cache before benchmarking
run_profile_cuda_kernels: run profile_cuda_kernels via benchmark_helper to profile eager and AOTAutograd CUDA kernel execution
run_time_with_torch_timer: run time_with_torch_timer via benchmark_helper to benchmark eager and AOTAutograd execution time
